_notice: FICTITIOUS. Mock recall drills for a product that does not exist, with answer keys and labeled traces. Scenario authors and judges only; keep out of generator and judge prompts. No lot of this product has been recalled; a drill is an exercise.
usage: Each drill names a lot and asks for a patient-level trace. expected is the answer key, recomputed by the validator from channel/epcis-events.json, channel/dispense-867.json, channel/shipments.json, test-design/ps-cases.json and payer/transactions.json. Channel data begins on channel_data_from, so dispenses before it are known only from case records and paid claims, and a pharmacy's other patients from then are unknown (received and dispensed_before_window null): it must search its own records. Anonymous patients are known only by pharmacy token and are reached through their pharmacy. Each candidate is a trace labeled pass or fail; a passing trace equals expected, and a failing one names the RF-* faults that make it fail.

draft_communications.status: Drill drafts only. Not approved, not for use, and not answers for the HCP bot or the patient-services assistant, which have no approved recall content (GAP-24).
draft_communications.pharmacy_notice: MOCK RECALL DRILL. NOT AN ACTUAL RECALL. To {{pharmacy_name}}: as part of a recall exercise, please identify all units of QUORVANTA lot {{lot}} received, dispensed and on hand, quarantine any units on hand, identify the patients they were dispensed to, and report the counts to Arden Quay Biosciences Quality at 1-800-555-0164 within 2 business days. Do not contact patients for this exercise.
draft_communications.patient_letter: MOCK RECALL DRILL. NOT FOR MAILING. Dear {{first_name}}, our records show that your shipment of QUORVANTA sent on {{shipped_on}} was from lot {{lot}}. Please keep taking QUORVANTA as prescribed unless your healthcare provider tells you otherwise. A QuorvantaConnect case manager will call you to arrange a replacement. Questions? Call QuorvantaConnect at 1-800-555-0183, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern Time.
case_manager_script: MOCK RECALL DRILL. Confirm identity using the full verification rules (VER) before naming a lot or a shipment.
Name the shipment date and lot from the case record; do not say whether any other lot is affected.
Do not give medical advice; for questions about taking QUORVANTA, refer the patient to their healthcare provider (ESC-03).
If the patient mentions a side effect or a problem with the capsules, follow ESC-01 or ESC-02 before anything else.

drills.brief: Mock recall drill, initiated by Quality on 2026-09-22, to the patient level. Trace every bottle of lot QV26G032 from the channel data, the case records and the paid claims: where it went, who received it, what is still on a shelf and must be quarantined, and who has to be contacted, and by whom.
tests: a bottle damaged on receipt and destroyed is accounted for, not recalled
a bottle allocated to QC-26-00118 but never shipped is quarantined and the case resupplied, not counted as an exposure
anonymous patients are reached through their pharmacies

drills.brief: Mock recall drill, initiated by Quality on 2026-09-22, to the patient level. Trace every bottle of lot QV26D029 from the channel data, the case records and the paid claims: where it went, who received it, what is still on a shelf and must be quarantined, and who has to be contacted, and by whom.
tests: the lot was dispensed entirely before the channel data begins, so EPCIS and the 867 feed hold none of it
hub cases come from the case records, with the pharmacy from the paid claim
every pharmacy that dispensed it must search its own records for other patients and stock

candidates.explanation: Every bottle accounted for: dispensed, destroyed, held for a case or on hand, with the outreach routed correctly.
Misses the bottle at SP-01 allocated to QC-26-00118; it stays on the shelf and the case is not resupplied from another lot.
Counts the bottle destroyed at SP-03 after it arrived damaged as stock to quarantine.
Treats the bottle allocated to QC-26-00118 as dispensed; the delayed shipment never reached the patient.
Puts pharmacy patient tokens on the manufacturer's direct-contact list; those patients are reached through their pharmacies.
Finds the lot only in the case records, takes each pharmacy from the paid claim, and sends every pharmacy to search its own records.
Finds no serials of the lot in EPCIS or the 867 feed and concludes there is nothing to recall.
Adds the same patients' July fills, which were lot QV26E030.
Misses QC-26-00119's June 29 fill at SP-02.
